document.description: Valid Canadian visas can unlock visa-free or simplified access beyond passport privileges

unlocks.conditions: Hold a Canadian visa valid on the day of entry into Georgia and present the travel and/or other appropriate document proving its validity. Visa-free stays are limited to 90 calendar days in any 180-day period.

source.verificationPath: Legislative Herald of Georgia > Ordinance No 256 of 5 June 2015 > annex, Canada (item 22), and Notes 1-2
source.exactQuote: Aliens holding a visa and/or a residence permit of any country listed in the annex may enter and stay in Georgia without visa for 90 calendar days in any 180-day period.
source.validityQuote: For the purpose of entering and staying in Georgia without visa, a visa and/or a residence permit of a respective country shall be valid on the day of entry into Georgia (crossing the border), which must be evidenced by a travel and/or other appropriate document.
source.notes: The English page is the initial edition. Checked against the MFA-hosted Georgian consolidated text and the listed 17 April 2025 amendment; that amendment adds conditions for specified Gulf-state documents, not Canadian visas.

currentTextSource.verificationPath: MFA legal-act PDF > page 2, Canada (item 22); page 3, entry conditions 1-3

amendmentSource.verificationPath: Ordinance No 122 of 17 April 2025 > Article 1, addition of condition 3

unlocks.notes: This entry covers Canadian visas. The 90-day allowance is cumulative within any 180 days, not a fresh 90 days per entry. It does not establish permission to work, study or reside in Georgia; other entry requirements still apply.

unlocks.conditions: Hold a valid multiple-entry Canadian visa. The Belize entry-visa exemption is for visits not exceeding 30 days; a single-entry Canadian visa does not meet the stated exemption.

source.verificationPath: Belize Immigration > Visa > Do you need a visa to travel to Belize? > Exemption for Belize Entry Visa for visits not exceeding 30 days
source.exactQuote: If you hold a valid multiple entry visa or Permanent Residence Card from Canada
source.maximumStayQuote: Exemption for Belize Entry Visa for visits not exceeding 30 days.
source.notes: The source lists a valid Canadian multiple-entry visa or Canadian Permanent Residence Card as alternative qualifying documents in the same bullet; this entry records only the visa route. The exemption list does not impose a passport-nationality restriction.

unlocks.notes: This entry covers the Canadian multiple-entry visa exemption, not permanent residence or Canadian eTA. A visa waiver does not waive other admission requirements or guarantee 30 days. Staying beyond the initial 30 days requires the appropriate Belize visitor permit extension.

unlocks.conditions: Hold a valid Canadian visa and a passport valid at entry and throughout the intended stay. The Mexican visa exemption applies regardless of nationality for tourism, business or transit, without engaging in paid activities in Mexico.

source.verificationPath: Consulate General of Mexico in Toronto > Services for foreigners > Visas > Important notice: Travelling to Mexico with a visa and Further information about the process of entering Mexico; Electronic Multiple Migratory Form for Air Travel
source.exactQuote: All foreign visitors, regardless of their nationality, traveling to Mexico for tourism, business or in transit to another destination, are exempt from presenting a Mexican visa as long as they have a valid visa issued by any the following countries: Canada, Japan, the United States of America, the United Kingdom or any of the countries comprising the Schengen Area.
source.maximumStayQuote: allow foreign visitors to remain in Mexico (without engaging in paid activities) for up to 180 days.
source.notes: The government page states Last Updated: 15 August 2025; accessed on 20 October 2026. Its separate linked visitor detail page redirected to a bot challenge and was not used as evidence.

unlocks.notes: This entry covers a Canadian visa, not a Canadian eTA or a work/study permit alone. The visa exemption does not guarantee admission or a 180-day stay: Mexican immigration officers decide admission and the permitted period. Other applicable entry requirements remain in force.

unlocks.conditions: Hold a valid multiple-entry Canadian visa and a valid passport. Entry without a Dominican consular visa applies strictly to tourist visits using a Tourist Card (Tarjeta de Turista); single-entry visas, Canadian eTAs, and work, study, or residence purposes are not covered.

source.verificationPath: MIREX > Portal Unico de Servicios > Servicios > Visas > Decreto Num. 691-07
source.exactQuote: El Decreto Núm. 691-07, del 18 de diciembre de 2007, facilita la entrada a la República Dominicana a extranjeros con residencia permanente o visado de entradas múltiples vigente en Estados Unidos, Unión Europea (Schengen), Canadá o Gran Bretaña. Pueden ingresar solo con pasaporte válido y una Tarjeta de Turismo para fines turísticos.

unlocks.notes: This entry records the Canadian multiple-entry visa exemption under Decreto Núm. 691-07, separately from Canadian permanent residence (recorded in CANADA-pr.json). Entry under this exemption is for tourist purposes with a valid passport and Tourist Card for up to 30 days and does not authorize work, study, or residence.

unlocks.conditions: Hold a valid visa for travel to Canada and present a valid passport. The visa exemption does not guarantee admission; a Border Force Officer determines entry on arrival.

source.verificationPath: Turks and Caicos Islands Border Force > Travel > Entry Requirements > Visa-required travellers
source.exactQuote: However, if you are a lawful resident of the United Kingdom, United States of America, or Canada, or hold a valid visa for travel to any of these three countries, you can enter the Turks and Caicos Islands without a visa.
source.admissionQuote: A Border Force Officer will determine whether you can enter TCI when you arrive.

staySource.verificationPath: GOV.UK > Foreign travel advice > Turks and Caicos Islands > Entry requirements > Visa requirements
staySource.exactQuote: On arrival, the immigration department will normally give you permission to stay for up to 90 days.

unlocks.notes: This entry records the valid Canadian visa route, separately from lawful Canadian residence (recorded in CANADA-pr.json). GOV.UK travel advice states that immigration normally grants up to 90 days on arrival, subject to Border Force determination and standard entry requirements.
